verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a narrow one-time-passcode generator (HOTP/TOTP) whose functions are syncing, transferring, organizing and displaying verification codes. A built-in agentic AI assistant for delegating tasks is outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows the product ships any AI assistant capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
